TransportCapacity.definition: The number of people each vehicle type can transport per shift.

Pollution.definition: The units of pollution each vehicle type produces per shift.

Earnings.definition: The earnings the company makes per shift from each vehicle type.

MaxVehiclePercentage.definition: The maximum proportion of the total number of vehicles that can be of each vehicle type.

PollutionCap.definition: The maximum total units of pollution allowed per shift.

MinTransportCapacity.definition: The minimum number of people that need to be transported per shift.
